name: HA MCP
description: Deploys the official Home Assistant MCP Server (ha-mcp) in HTTP mode via uvx, giving HTTP-capable MCP clients a LAN endpoint to control Home Assistant in natural language.

notes.text: Install asks for the HA URL (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8123) and a long-lived token (HA Profile → Security). Unattended: `var_ha_url=... var_ha_token=...` with ct/ha-mcp.sh.
Do not expose port 8086 without a reverse proxy. Keep HA and this LXC on the same LAN/VLAN.
HTTP on 8086 with an auto-generated MCP_SECRET_PATH. Connect to http://<ip>:8086/mcp-<secret>; a browser GET returns 405, which is expected.
Test from inside the container: `curl -sf -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" http://YOUR_HA_IP:8123/api/`; use http:// unless HTTPS is configured.
Endpoint file: /opt/ha-mcp/mcp_endpoint.txt. Update: `update` in the LXC or `pct exec <CTID> -- update`. Settings UI: http://<ip>:8086/mcp-<secret>/settings.
HA OS users may prefer the official MCP add-on. To federate several ha-mcp LXCs behind one MCP URL, install agentgateway.
